	# [armor-class-handoff] The inf-support FINAL: the line shape the GENERATED medium role
	# targets when the infantry-support variant wins its chain and the industrial cut leaves no
	# support battalion (7 armour + 3 infantry-support + 5 mechanized), so the medium role's
	# best-match capture sees its own target instead of a shape it never claims. Reached from

				infantry_heavy_mechanized_battalion_line = 5
				medium_armor_battalion_line = 7

				anti_tank_mot_company_regimental = 5
				pack_artillery_mot_company_regimental = 5

				engineer_med_tank_battalion_divisional = 1
